$comment: Hand-curated corrections, applied by scripts/build.mjs. Kept out of the fragment files so the fix is one reviewable list rather than 30 scattered edits, and so the original authoring is preserved.

kind._note: Nodes typed `process` whose subject is a SUBSTANCE, not an operation. Found by scanning all 1,702 process-kind nodes, then reviewed by hand: a regex first flagged 173 candidates, but most were correct processes that merely mention a substance ('Gold WIRE wedge bonding' matched on 'wire'). Only these are genuinely misfiled. Several keep children describing their production, which is fine and desirable -- a material whose making is documented beneath it.
kind._note2: Equipment, not a process: the scrubber is a vessel in the flue.
kind._note3: A group of people is a facility in the taxonomy, not an operation.

editorialNote: Nodes that are commentary or scaffolding rather than a thing in the supply chain. Flagged, hidden by default, never deleted. Two traps learned the hard way: (1) the three spine branches (c64.peripherals, c64.extras, c64.bottoms-out) are scaffolding but are also the ONLY route to the television, cassette and metals subtrees; (2) unlinked.catalogue is a filing artefact by name, but it is the sole parent of ~377 published metal/material nodes, so hiding it hides real content. Neither is listed. Only genuine commentary.
